title: 2014 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Harry and Terry are each told to calculate \(8-(2+5).\) Harry gets the correct answer. Terry ignores the parentheses and calculates \(8-2+5.\) If Harry’s answer is \(H\) and Terry’s answer is \(T,\) what is \(H-T?\)

solutions.text:
Harry calculates it correctly as follows: \[\begin{align*} 8 - (2 + 5) &= 8 - 7 \\ &= 1. \end{align*}\] Terry calculates it incorrectly as follows: \[\begin{align*} 8 - 2 + 5 &= 6 + 5 \\ &= 11. \end{align*}\] Therefore: \[\begin{align*} H - T &= 1 - 11 \\ &= -10. \end{align*}\]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Compute inside the parentheses first for Harry.
Compare Harry’s result with Terry’s left-to-right calculation.
